evidence: Inspected the actual frozen XLSX with openpyxl: Quality Checks!row 4 says 'No real spelling errors and nothing pasted in by mistake (author notes, TODOs, other machines’ paths, contradictions).' Internal Quality Checks!row 4 uses the equivalent 'stray paths' wording and has no additional cell comments. Also read Deterministic Checks!rows 13 and 14 and the frozen Harbor quality-checks.md section 3, deterministic-checks.md:58 and :68-78, and staged-task-contract.md sections Closed file list and Cross-file agreements. All task-relative citations below are rooted at .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-postrepair-audit/task/. Read instruction.md and every one of the six environment/instructions/*.md files completely. Manual spelling and semantic review found no genuine misspelling, author aside, pasted drafting text, or contradictory product instruction; 'colouring', 'colours' and 'behaviour' are valid English variants. Read-only Python checks covered all seven files (1,830 whitespace-delimited words; instruction.md has 232): zero TODO/FIXME/XXX/CHANGE_ME/placeholder/lorem-ipsum hits, zero author-machine-path hits, zero selected grader-vocabulary hits, zero replacement/control characters and zero duplicated substantial paragraphs within any file. These are local checks and manual review, not a private portal checker run. instruction.md:5 says 'Please read the six notes in /instructions'; exactly those six notes exist and environment/Dockerfile:14 copies instructions/ to /instructions/. instruction.md:1 says 'No accounts or sign-in'; overview.md:7, policy.md:3 and tests/app_context.md Accounts consistently describe one shared library. instruction.md:5 names /assets/seed_data.json, integration.md:9 uses the same path, and environment/assets/seed_data.json states no implementation or starter files are supplied. Its empty supplied snippets array is consistent with overview.md:3 allowing app examples or an already-saved snippet as the opening state, and overview.md:9 separates examples from user records. integration.md:5-9 consistently specifies /app/server.js, 0.0.0.0:3000, /app/public/index.html, /api/health, /app/app.db with DB_PATH override, and copying required local assets into /app; these are intended container paths, not another author's workstation. behaviour.md:9 and security.md:5 both say five seconds, while behaviour.md:11 explicitly preserves deliberate interaction with a successfully completed preview; tests/app_context.md Runtime expectations repeats that distinction. instruction.md:9 permits external assets for the app itself; integration.md:11 and security.md:9 explicitly distinguish those assets from prohibited network access by entered snippets. No competing clock, account list or seed path was found. Independently recomputed all 50 frozen task-file and 34 frozen rule-file SHA256 values against manifest.json: zero mismatches. In-memory positive/negative hygiene controls left a US-spelling variant clean and detected both the TODO and workstation path in a deliberately contaminated copy. No task bytes were edited. This static row does not require a configured judge run; unavailable full judge, Oracle and target-model measurements are not represented as passing evidence.
counterexample: A plausible false-fail candidate is a conforming app that loads its editor from a CDN while denying snippet network access: instruction.md:9, integration.md:11 and security.md:9 explicitly make these separate policies, so their coexistence is not contradictory contamination. Likewise the actual British spelling 'syntax colouring' at ui.md:5 is valid; an in-memory replacement with 'syntax coloring' also produced zero hygiene-marker hits. A deliberately broken instruction copy with 'TODO: copy final draft from C:/Users/Author/Desktop/old-task.md' appended was tried only in memory and correctly produced both draft-marker and author-path hits. No corresponding false-pass or false-fail defect was found in the frozen candidate. These controls test instruction hygiene, not application behavior or judge scoring.
